items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And Jimmie Mundie, and for the pretty songs, we had Paul Wetstein.

ctx.x: But his original work was with Hines in Chicago?
Oh, he wrote for everybody. And Jimmie Mundie, and for the pretty songs, we had Paul Wetstein.
Name some of those tunes, Cliff - can you remember any of them?
